en: A vintage postcard featuring on the front a historical black-and-white photograph of a formal group of men and women, many in military uniforms with medals, officials, clergy, and well-dressed women, likely commemorating a significant political or national event. On the reverse side, the card is addressed in Bulgarian, contains a Bulgarian postage stamp, a postmark from 1909, and handwritten correspondence. There is also printed text referencing celebrations of independence in 'В.-Тирново' (Veliko Tarnovo).
